# Query planner, explain plans and covered queries — concept pack

> How a database decides to use an index: explain plans (explain(), EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN, executionStats), index scans versus collection/table scans, covered queries, selectivity and cardinality, the ESR guideline for compound-index key order, hints, in-memory sorts, and the Convex rule that an index is only used through withIndex. Child pack of Indexing.
